name: Everly
description: Everly is an AI-native wedding planner. Connect it to Claude and your assistant can run your wedding planning end to end: find wedding vendors in Everly's vetted catalog by category, city, or "near me"; read and reply to your vendor conversations (messages are delivered to vendors by email — no new inbox to check); start new inquiries; import email threads you had outside Everly; attach contracts and quotes so everything lives in one place; and manage your full guest list with RSVP tracking and custom columns. Everly can also reply to vendors for you: turn AI auto-response on per conversation and Everly drafts and sends replies, escalating to you only when a decision needs human input — those escalations are readable and resolvable right from Claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add Everly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Everly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.everly.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Everly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everly lists 21 MCP tools, including conversations_attach_documents, conversations_files, conversations_get, conversations_import, conversations_links, conversations_list, conversations_send_message, conversations_set_ai_auto_response, conversations_start, escalations_get, escalations_list, and escalations_resolve.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Everly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Everly in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Everly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Everly is developed by Middle Lake, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
